evidence: Quick Design-only accessibility review of specs/spec.md, design/design.md, and design/contract.json. The provisional Design changes synchronous Python governance, native-dispatch observation, Git-checkout evidence, and exact-SHA terminal projection ownership; it introduces no browser or native UI, interactive control, keyboard/focus path, ARIA contract, accessible-name surface, visual contrast or pointer interaction, authentication flow, or review-widget presentation. WCAG 2.2 AA implementation concerns are therefore explicitly non-applicable to this Design.
